label: Definition
subgoals: Check that every input-to-node path crosses the set
Bound the set size by k
Include the trivial cut containing the node itself

label: Bottom-up enumeration
subgoals: Give each primary input its trivial cut
Merge every pair of fanin cuts and keep unions of size at most k
Add the node's trivial cut and remove duplicate sets

label: Dominance and priority cuts
subgoals: Find cuts that strictly contain another cut of the same node
Keep only a few best cuts per node in large designs
